1. The service

Trama is garment production control software offered by Trama. It includes the iPad and Android app that works without internet, the web version and encrypted sync between devices, according to the plan purchased.

2. Licence

We grant your company a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence to use Trama during the contracted term, within the limits of its plan (users, devices and plants). Trama is licensed, not sold. The software, its design and its brand belong to Trama.

The apps are distributed privately to licensed customers and must not be shared with third parties.

3. Permitted use

Your company agrees not to:

  • Resell, sublicense, rent or make Trama available to anyone outside your company.
  • Copy, modify, decompile or attempt to obtain the source code, except where the law expressly allows it.
  • Circumvent licence limits, role permissions or security measures.
  • Use Trama for unlawful activities or to store information that infringes third-party rights.

4. Accounts and security

Your company's administrator creates and manages users and their roles. Each user must keep their password secret and report any unauthorised use immediately. Your company is responsible for activity carried out with its accounts, for deactivating people who should no longer have access and for releasing lost devices.

5. Your data

The information your company enters in Trama belongs to your company. You authorise us to process it only to provide, secure and support the service, as described in the privacy notice. Your company warrants that it has the authorisations needed to record the data of its employees, clients and suppliers.

The apps store information on each device and can export backups. We recommend making regular backups.

6. Plans, prices and payments

  • Published prices are in US dollars, per company per month, excluding taxes. Annual billing includes two months free.
  • Payment terms, term length and invoicing are set out in your company's quote or contract.
  • We may update prices; changes apply from the next renewal and we will notify you in advance.
  • Unless the law provides otherwise, payments for periods already started are non-refundable.

7. Expiry and suspension

If the licence expires or is suspended for non-payment or breach of these terms, information remains available in read-only mode so nothing is lost, but no new changes can be recorded until renewal. We may suspend access immediately in case of misuse or security risk.

8. Availability and support

The iPad and Android apps keep working without internet; sync and the web version depend on the connection and on third-party services. We make reasonable efforts to keep the platform available and to announce maintenance, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted service unless a service level is agreed in writing (Enterprise plan). Support is provided through the agreed channels.

9. Warranties and liability

Trama is provided "as is" and according to its documentation. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits or data loss resulting from not making backups, and our total liability to your company is limited to the amount paid for the licence in the 12 months before the event giving rise to it.

10. Termination

Your company may stop renewing at any time. When the licence ends, it can request a backup of its information and its deletion from the cloud, as described in the privacy notice.

11. Changes to these terms

We may modify these terms. We will publish the current version on this page and notify administrators when the change is significant. Continuing to use Trama after the notice means accepting the new version.

12. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the United Mexican States. For any dispute, the parties submit to the competent courts of Mexico City, waiving any other jurisdiction that may apply.
